content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To calculate the area of an ellipse, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Identify the center point of the ellipse on the graph (2 minutes)
Step 2. Mark the vertex points on the major axis (1 minute)
Step 3. Calculate the distance from the center to a focus (5 minutes)
Step 4. Determine the length of the semi-major axis 'a' (3 minutes)
Step 5. Calibrate the measuring compass (2 minutes)
Step 6. Sketch the auxiliary circles (10 minutes)
Step 7. Verify the symmetry across the y-axis (4 minutes)
Step 8. Draft the initial bounding box (6 minutes)
Step 9. Measure the distance between the two foci (4 minutes)
Step 10. Record the final coordinates of the center (1 minute)
Step 11. Calculate the square of the semi-major axis (2 minutes)
Step 12. Locate the intersection points of the axes (5 minutes)
Step 13. Double-check the focus-to-vertex ratio (3 minutes)
Step 14. Define the horizontal span of the ellipse (4 minutes)
Step 15. Set the decimal precision for the calculation (1 minute)
Step 16. Apply the area constant multiplier (2 minutes)
Step 17. Note the orientation of the ellipse (2 minutes)
Step 18. Cross-reference the minor axis length with the graph (3 minutes)
Step 19. Identify the semi-minor axis 'b' (4 minutes)
Step 20. Confirm the value of 'a' is greater than 'b' (1 minute)
Step 21. Perform a sanity check on the eccentricity (2 minutes)
Step 22. Clean the drafting table surface (5 minutes)
Step 23. Locate the directrix lines (8 minutes)
Step 24. Outline the curvature of the first quadrant (12 minutes)
Step 25. Sharpen the drafting pencils (3 minutes)
Step 26. Plot the points for the second quadrant (10 minutes)
Step 27. Gather the ruler and string (2 minutes)
Step 28. Measure the total width of the shape (3 minutes)
Step 29. Log the width in the workbook (1 minute)
Step 30. Calculate the ratio of the axes (4 minutes)
Step 31. Determine the product of 'a' and 'b' (2 minutes)
Step 32. Verify the focal property sum (5 minutes)
Step 33. Open the geometry textbook to the reference page (1 minute)
Step 34. Shade the interior of the ellipse (15 minutes)
Step 35. Draw the latus rectum (6 minutes)
Step 36. Consult a colleague on the methodology (20 minutes)
Step 37. Finalize the values of 'a' and 'b' (2 minutes)
Step 38. Select the appropriate formula for area (1 minute)
Step 39. Write down the value of Pi to five decimals (1 minute)
Step 40. Label the major axis on the diagram (2 minutes)
Step 41. Verify the units of measurement (2 minutes)
Step 42. Check the compass for mechanical errors (3 minutes)
Step 43. Calculate the product of the semi-axes (3 minutes)
Step 44. Review the initial problem statement (5 minutes)
Step 45. Calculate the eccentricity of the ellipse (5 minutes)
Step 46. Check the mathematical proof for the area formula (15 minutes)
Step 47. Sketch the minor axis on the grid (5 minutes)
Step 48. Prepare the final report template (10 minutes)
Step 49. Check for rounding errors in the intermediate steps (6 minutes)
Step 50. Determine the coordinate of the top vertex (2 minutes)
Step 51. Solve for the focal length (4 minutes)
Step 52. Measure the distance from center to co-vertex (4 minutes)
Step 53. Multiply the product by Pi (2 minutes)
Step 54. Highlight the perimeter of the ellipse (5 minutes)
Step 55. Calculate the distance from focus to co-vertex (4 minutes)
Step 56. Clean the plastic protractor (2 minutes)
Step 57. Formulate the final equation (3 minutes)
Step 58. Identify the vertices on the minor axis (4 minutes)
Step 59. Set the paper on the drafting board (2 minutes)
Step 60. Check the graph for any distortions (5 minutes)
Step 61. Clean the calculator screen (1 minute)
Step 62. Find the area of the bounding rectangle (4 minutes)
Step 63. Determine the slope of the tangent at the vertex (7 minutes)
Step 64. Check the scale of the graph paper (2 minutes)
Step 65. Calculate the area of one quadrant (5 minutes)
Step 66. Mark the co-vertices on the minor axis (3 minutes)
Step 67. Sum the areas of the four quadrants (4 minutes)
Step 68. Review the final numerical result (3 minutes)
Step 69. Locate a quiet workspace (10 minutes)
Step 70. Draw the focal chords (6 minutes)
Step 71. Adjust the desk lamp for better lighting (1 minute)
Step 72. Compare the result with a circle of radius 'a' (5 minutes)
Step 73. Re-measure the semi-minor axis for accuracy (4 minutes)
Step 74. Label the foci as F1 and F2 (2 minutes)
Step 75. Verify the pencil lead thickness (1 minute)
Step 76. Double-check the multiplication of 'a' and 'b' (2 minutes)
Step 77. Secure the paper with drafting tape (2 minutes)
Step 78. Note the angle of rotation if any (3 minutes)
Step 79. Check the ink level in the technical pen (2 minutes)
Step 80. Wipe the drafting triangles (2 minutes)
Step 81. Set the calculator to radian mode (1 minute)
Step 82. Re-verify the distance between vertices (3 minutes)
Step 83. Scan the grid for alignment (4 minutes)
Step 84. Plot the co-vertex points (3 minutes)
Step 85. Check the final units of the area (1 minute)
Step 86. Re-examine the symmetry across the x-axis (4 minutes)
Step 87. Refresh the memory on the area of a circle (2 minutes)
Step 88. Confirm the length of the minor axis (2 minutes)
Step 89. Retrieve the drafting kit from the drawer (5 minutes)
Step 90. Write the final area value in square units (1 minute)
